ear_source.use: The two source ear components were extracted from head_org_0_0_node and parented to CC_Base_Head.

walk_adjustments.arm_trajectory: analytic two-bone retiming; lateral 0.58, longitudinal 1.30, right longitudinal multiplier 1.327
walk_adjustments.finger_animation: 24 finger bones frozen at first-frame rotation
walk_adjustments.ear_placement: world -Y forward 0.050; no world-X inward translation; outer rim pivots toward face around ear root, world-Z 12 degrees

known_limitations: Side-view rear-foot silhouette can appear longer because of stride projection and overlap; Foot/Toe rotation scaling did not remove it.
This package intentionally contains the selected walk baseline only. Run is preserved as a source FBX for the next retarget pass.
